snippet.title: Forgotten Memories - Full Walkthrough and Speedrun
snippet.description:
This is a walkthrough/speed run of Forgotten Memories: Alternate Realities for iOS. I used the developer console (unlocked after beating the game) to unlock all weapons for the sake of convenience.

This is a "bare basics" walkthrough and will only show you the necessary items required to complete the game. All cutscenes were skipped and none of the side-quests are shown.

iOS App Store link:
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/forgotten-memories-alternate/id834715612
